resolution.description: What the target contributes to the scan, whether it has no addresses, or the error the scan would abort on.

target.description: The target as written in the scenario.

ResolvedAddresses.description: What a target contributes to the scan: how many addresses the stream yields for it, and the first few of them.

sample.description: The first of those addresses, at most six of them — a plan never carries a target's whole address space.

total.description: Addresses the scan would probe for this target.

oneOf.description: This target resolved to no addresses; the scan probes it zero times and runs on.
The scan would abort on this target rather than run without it.

description: Structured plan of a single discovery scenario — what a dry-run would probe, without executing it.

classifier.description: Human-readable summary of the resolved classifier.

encoder.description: Wire format records leave in: `ndjson` or `table`.

fuser.description: Human-readable summary of the resolved fuser chain, outermost layer first.

max_concurrent.description: Effective in-flight probe cap for this run.

probers.description: Human-readable summary of each configured prober.

refusal.description: Error the scan would abort on before its first probe; absent when the scan would start, which a target with no addresses does not prevent.

retries.description: Effective retransmit attempts for connectionless probers.

scenario.description: Name of the scenario this plan describes.

sink.description: Human-readable summary of where records would go; several destinations, comma-separated, when the run fans out.

targets.description: Each configured target with what it contributes to the scan, whether it has no addresses, or the error the scan would abort on.

total_probes.description: Total probes the scan would run: every address it would probe times probers, `0` when it would abort first. A resumed plan counts only what the checkpoint left, so it sits below the sum of the per-target totals.

title: DiscoveryPlan
